target_customer: Pharma, hospitals, medical device makers and private clinics
problem: Patients leave care without understanding instructions, so providers chase them and readmissions and non-adherence follow.
business_model: B2B SaaS for providers and life science companies, pricing not found
product_category: AI personalized patient education video and engagement

founders.name: Tane Kim
education: Brown University, dropped out of the BS/MD program
founders.background_notes: Described on the YC page as a med school dropout who observed 500 plus patient interactions at over a dozen institutions.

founders.name: David Cui
founders.background_notes: The YC page gives only David; surname comes from search coverage and the LinkedIn URL. The founders met at Brown freshman orientation.

competitors.name: Vital
competitors.what: Urgent care platform with an AI powered video education feature drawing on 2,000 plus videos and EHR data

competitors.name: GistMD
competitors.what: Generates narrated animated patient videos from EHR data, partnered with Mayo Clinic

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating personalized video from records is feasible with current models, but clinical accuracy review, EHR integration and privacy compliance are hard.

defensibility.rationale: Engagement data could compound, but video generation and templates are copyable and EHR vendors can add similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known; AI video education already existed from Vital in 2023 and research systems appeared in 2025.

market_need_then: A review notes no clinical data has been published showing fewer readmissions, so demand is argued from the discharge problem rather than shown by results.

branding.domain_note: Uses framewisehealth.com, the name plus a health suffix.

identity.voice_and_tone: Patient friendly: videos for every patient

brand_strength.rationale: A new compound name with no brand press; one trademark search surfaced the similar Framework Health name owned by another firm.

outcome_analysis: Framewise Health is a Spring 2026 company with two Brown founders and is active, with no shutdown or layoff news. Funding sources disagree (125k to 500k dollars) so no round is recorded. Success will hinge on clinical evidence and hospital pilots, as AI patient video already has entrants.
notes: Unverified funding: CB Insights lists 500k dollars as a convertible note, FundedIQ and VCBacked list a 500k pre-seed in June 2026, Dealroom lists 125k seed. No investor beyond Y Combinator named, so no round recorded. framewisehealth.com could not be fetched because the safety check was rate limited, not because the site is dead. One competitor entry (GistMD) is undated in the source.
